question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

We all must agree on the fact that life is __fragile__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Healthy**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence is '**fragile**'. '**Fragile**' describes something that is easily broken or damaged. (नाज़ुक)

 
 
• **Example**: This antique vase is very **fragile**, and needs to be handled with care.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym here is '**healthy**'. '**Healthy**' refers to being in good health, strong or robust. It also implies being able to withstand the pressures or rigours of life, which is opposite to '**fragile**'. (स्वस्थ)
 
 
• **Example**: She follows a balanced diet to stay **healthy**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**fragile**' is '**healthy**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: '**Infirm**' is similar in meaning to 'fragile', not opposite. It refers to someone not in robust good health, often due to age or illness. (अशक्त)
 
• Option 3: '**Violent**' doesn't directly contrast 'fragile'. It refers to using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill. (हिंसक)
 
• Option 4: '**Weak**' is actually synonymous with 'fragile', meaning not strong or sturdy. (कमजोर)
